scripts.prebuild: npm --prefix ../simulator run build && npm run clean
scripts.coverage: npm run build && c8 --reporter=text --reporter=lcov --all --include=dist/services/**/*.js --include=dist/scripts/_*.js --include=dist/services/indicators/**/*.js node --experimental-strip-types test/run-tests.ts
scripts.coverage:check: npm run build && c8 --check-coverage --lines 90 --functions 90 --statements 90 --reporter=text --all --include=dist/services/**/*.js --include=dist/scripts/_*.js --include=dist/services/indicators/**/*.js node --experimental-strip-types test/run-tests.ts
